nodes.label: wkc-setup
nodes.summary: Configure project conventions, document paths, and the selected issue tracker.

details.body: Interview the user and record choices in docs/dev-agents/config.md, with one reference in the project context file. Output: project configuration, rules, and context references; create missing GitHub status labels for this repository’s selected tracker.
details.when: Use when adopting the development skills or changing project configuration.

nodes.label: wkc-research
nodes.summary: Write or update the product requirements document (PRD) from research material and an interview.

details.body: Reads config, context, rules, the current PRD, and supplied material, then asks only what the material leaves open. Output: the PRD at `prd_file`, default docs/dev-agents/PRD.md, with a draft or approved status line; wkc-architect reads an approved PRD next.
details.when: Use when starting a product or making a change that shifts its goals, users, or scope.

nodes.label: wkc-architect
nodes.summary: Write or update the technical specification (SPEC) and ADRs from an approved PRD and the existing code.

details.body: Shows options and tradeoffs before committing to a choice, and writes an ADR only for a decision costly to reverse. Output: the SPEC at `spec_file` and ADRs; a contract change with a configured tracker lists affected open tickets through wkc-tracker list.
details.when: Use after a PRD is approved, or for a change that needs new contracts, components, or a recorded decision.

nodes.label: wkc-plan
nodes.summary: Write or update the ROADMAP, the ordered milestones that deliver an approved SPEC, and close a finished milestone.

details.body: Orders milestones by dependency and risk, each with an outcome and an exit check, and reads milestones through wkc-tracker; wkc-plan close <milestone> closes one once every ticket is terminal and the person confirms its exit check. Output: the ROADMAP at `roadmap_file`, with no tickets; an approved milestone goes to wkc-backlog.
details.when: Use when a design needs milestones, when a change adds, moves, or drops milestone scope, or to close a finished milestone.

nodes.label: wkc-backlog
nodes.summary: Draft one milestone's tickets, or one change to the tickets, and publish them through wkc-tracker.

details.body: Drafts tickets from the SPEC's ticket templates with a checked dependency graph, after reading the PRD, SPEC, ROADMAP, and existing tickets. Output: after approval, tickets created, edited, linked, and moved only through wkc-tracker verbs.
details.when: Use when a milestone needs tickets, or for one change: a request, a bug, discovered work, or a split, re-block, or cancel.

nodes.label: wkc-tracker
nodes.summary: Read and update tickets in the configured GitHub, Linear, or local backend.

details.body: Reads issue_tracker from docs/dev-agents/config.md, which wkc-setup writes. Reads and changes GitHub Issues here; provides list, show, next, create, edit, assign, comment, move, link, unlink, and milestone across seven statuses.
details.when: Use after wkc-setup to read tickets, change ticket state, or find work ready to start.

nodes.label: wkc-implement
nodes.summary: Take one ready ticket to an open pull request at in-review, and after the merge run its post-merge steps and move it to done.

details.body: Claims the ticket, builds, runs its acceptance checks, opens the pull request, and hands off, with every ticket write through wkc-tracker verbs and no merge. After the merge, wkc-implement finish <id> runs the post-merge gates, or opens a follow-up pull request when one fails because of the change, and names wkc-plan close <milestone> when the ticket's milestone has nothing open.
details.when: Use when a ready ticket should become a pull request, and run wkc-implement finish <id> after a person merges it.

nodes.label: wkc-code-review
nodes.summary: Run one review round on a pull request from wkc-implement and post a verdict: approve, fixed, or stopped.

details.body: Judges the change against its ticket and the SPEC, and while fixing rounds are left, fixes verified blocking findings and applies worthwhile in-scope improvements in one pushed commit, without moving the ticket or merging. Each change is reviewed by another round in a fresh session, up to max_fix_attempts, and only a fresh session approves.
details.when: Use after wkc-implement hands a ticket to review, and again after each fixed round, in a fresh session.

nodes.label: wkc-workflow-diagram
nodes.summary: Create or update an offline map from actual workflow definitions and authored diagram data.

details.body: Output: workflow.json, layout.json, offline HTML, notes, and screenshots under docs/dev-agents/diagram/. Read skill definitions without executing them; wkc-setup and config are optional.
details.when: Use to explain project skills or update a map after workflow changes.

nodes.label: wkc-help
nodes.summary: Answer questions about these skills and manage their installation when requested.

details.body: Read installed definitions to explain skill behavior and invocation. Use npx skills to install, pin, update, or remove skills only when a person requests the change; installation does not invoke installed skills.
details.when: Use for questions about these skills, their installed versions, or installation management.

nodes.label: wkc-skills-release
nodes.summary: Publish this collection's lightweight tags and stable GitHub Releases after maintainer authorization.

details.body: Internal maintainer skill for wilsonkichoi/skills, excluded from ordinary bulk installation. Output: verified lightweight tags and stable GitHub Releases; publish merged work from clean synchronized main with authenticated GitHub access, without setup or project configuration.
details.when: Use when the maintainer explicitly requests a collection release or recovery after interrupted publication.
